turns.t: Good morning. You are Kavitha Raman, yes? Please tell me if I am saying your name wrongly.
No, no, it is correct, doctor. Kavitha Raman.
Lovely. Please sit, Kavitha. Tell me, what is troubling you?
It is... there is a swelling in my neck. I noticed, um... actually my sister noticed it first.
A swelling in your neck, and your sister saw it first. When was that?
Three months back, maybe. In a photo. She said, 'what is that', and then I...
Take your time. And since then, has it changed, bigger, smaller, same?
A little bigger, I think. Or maybe I am only looking at it more now.
That is fair. Does it cause any trouble when you are eating or drinking?
Sometimes food gets stuck. Especially rice, if I eat fast. Then I drink water and it goes.
So food gets stuck sometimes, mostly when you eat fast. Is the swelling painful?
No. No pain.
Any difficulty in breathing, even when you lie down at night?
No, breathing is okay.
And your voice, has it become hoarse or different?
No... same only.
Good. Anything else you have noticed, anything at all? Even something small.
I am feeling very tired, doctor. Mostly in the evenings. I thought it is work.
Very tired in the evenings. Thank you for telling me. Any other health condition, anything you are known for?
Only PCOS. Since college days.
PCOS, okay. What work do you do, and how is your food, vegetarian or not?
I work in a bank. Vegetarian, mostly. Sometimes egg.
Okay. Now I will examine your neck. Please take a sip of water, hold it in your mouth, and swallow when I say.
Like this?
Yes, now swallow. And again. One more time.
Your thyroid gland is enlarged, Kavitha, and it moves up when you swallow. It feels smooth and even.
Doctor, is it... is it something serious?

Let me tell you what I found, so we are both clear. A swelling for three months, no pain, food sticking sometimes, and a smooth enlarged gland. This looks like a goitre, which means an enlarged thyroid.
Goitre. I have never heard this word before.
It is a common word for it, so please do not worry. First we need to know how your thyroid is working, so I would like a thyroid blood test today itself.
Today? Okay.
Doctor, shall I take her to the sample room? The phlebotomist is free now.
Yes, please, Meena. Kavitha, Meena will take your blood. It is a small prick, nothing more.
Okay. And after that I can go home?
Yes. Go home, eat normally and rest. And remember, if the swelling grows quickly, or the swallowing becomes worse, come back to me straightaway.
Straightaway. Yes, I will remember.
Good. So the plan is a blood test today, and coming back quickly if it grows or swallowing worsens. You have done well, Kavitha.
Thank you, doctor. I was very afraid to come.
Many people are. Go with Meena now.
